What sets up apart:
The only true dual vessel HAST Chamber. Condensation and contamination free test environment with controlled humidity during ramp down. The ideal HAST stress test chamber and environment for Semiconductors, substrates, and materials. When accuracy and precision counts, the Pioneers and inventors of HAST, Hirayama is the world-renowned Brand.
Integrated Graphical
User interface for convenience process and realtime system performance.
The Pioneers in HAST Technology.
Hirayama Manufacturing company has been making pressure vessels and medical sterilizers for over 100+ years.  All manufactured and produced in Japan with the most widely installed worldwide user base.  They are pioneers of this technology. When accuracy and precision counts, the Pioneers, and inventors of HAST, Hirayama is the world-renowned Brand.
Semiconductor is a specialty application sector for the chambers. It is used in materials, metals, laminates, lumber, chemical, drug, tool manufacturing and other industries worldwide.
Key Advantages on the Hirayama Technology
The only true dual vessel, HAST Chamber.  Condensation is eliminated as there is no condensation or rain inside the chamber.
Air exhaust pre-pressurization to provide a more accurate and uniform environment.
Adaptable to 100+ voltage bias or test terminals for in-situ measurements.
Self-contained DI water reservoir that passes water though an anti-bacterial filter and Self-contained DI water reservoir that passes water though an anti-bacterial filter.
Motorized door opening to ensure uniform opening and shutting of the door to chamber interface, eliminating any leaks, water drops, or condensation catch basin requirements and Ease of diagnostics and Bias check on Test Boards
An air evaluation cycle at the start of the test with a complete Humidity Maintenance and control option (switch selectable) for a controlled exhaust. It is a vital necessity and benefit for semiconductors, SSOP packages and laminates. Protects against any depressurization stresses to the Test samples.
